casual5.custom:
A single vertical 2:3, 1024×1536 anime_25d_gloss illustration of the fictional adult woman Magby, now off duty as a harbor ferry attendant. Match the attached selected character reference in facial proportions, warm skin tone, ember-red almond eyes, vivid short red hair in a high loose bun, curled wisps around the ears, and the small gold flame hair clip. She is a mature woman in her late twenties with natural adult proportions.

At an open ferry shelter in a colorful Pokémon-world seaside harbor, she checks the needle on a brass wind gauge fixed to the railing before the afternoon ferry departs. She stands in a relaxed front three-quarter pose at eye-level camera height, waist-up in the foreground. Her near hand steadies the gauge rim, her other hand rests open on the wooden railing. She turns her eyes toward the viewer with a small welcoming smile. Show both wrists and both anatomically connected hands, five fingers per hand with natural overlap, relaxed shoulders, and a naturally proportioned neck. The brass instrument has tick marks and a needle, without lettering. Mooring ropes, a white ferry with navy trim, glass floats, a bright turquoise harbor, and pastel waterfront buildings establish the location. A daylight sea breeze lifts only the loose wisps of hair and the ends of a narrow ochre scarf.

Her practical daywear is a cobalt canvas chore jacket over an ivory ribbed mock-neck shirt, an ochre neck scarf, and dark straight-leg utility trousers. Show crisp jacket stitching, fabric folds at elbows, worn brass snaps, and a small red-and-white enamel ball-shaped pin on the jacket. Render a polished Japanese anime 2.5D look with fine subtle linework, soft facial gradients, a restrained luminous sheen on visible skin, layered red hair with delicate strand highlights, and separate treatments for canvas, brass, painted wood, and seawater. Clear bright afternoon lighting. One person, one continuous scene, no readable text, no logos, no border.
